KeepActive Control Deck

Fine-tune activity intervals, work schedules, and safety boundaries

Teams Web Activity Intervals (Seconds)

Activity events trigger at randomized intervals within this range to add natural variation.

Automated Work Shifts

Automatically engages Teams Web activity during specified shifts and pauses outside active working hours.

Active Workdays

Smart Pause (OS Idle Detection)

Pauses activity whenever you interact with the workstation, and resumes once you become continuously idle.

Native Desktop Helper (Optional)

Full build only. While you are idle, the helper nudges the operating-system pointer by a few pixels and restores it. This gives Microsoft Teams Desktop a real local input event. It never clicks, types text, or runs while you are actively using the keyboard or mouse.

Helper disabled

Install from the full package: native\install.ps1 -ExtensionId <your extension ID>. On macOS/Linux use native/install.sh --extension-id <id>. Reload the extension after installing. Teams Desktop presence is controlled by Microsoft and is not guaranteed.
